ideas.about: Research, strategy, competitor analysis, finding angles
ideas.about_ar: بحث، استراتيجية، تحليل منافسين، زوايا جديدة

content.about: Scripts, hooks, titles, voice, writing for every platform
content.about_ar: سكريبتات، هوكات، عناوين، صوتك الخاص، كتابة لكل منصة

motion.about_ar: موشن جرافيك بالكود، Remotion، صوت، محاكاة

pro.about_ar: مونتاج، كابشنز، تلوين، Reframe، تقطيع كليبات

packs.about_ar: سكيل واحدة بتشغّل أي سكيلز تانية متركّبة عندك.

packs.about_ar: اكتب، وحط كابشنز، وظبّط السيو لفيديوهاتك العربي بلهجتك.

packs.about: Plan, script, package and grow a YouTube channel.
packs.about_ar: خطط، واكتب، وجهّز، ونمّي قناتك على يوتيوب.

packs.about: Hooks, scripts, captions and vertical reframing.
packs.about_ar: هوكات، وسكريبتات، وكابشنز، وتحويل للفيديو الطولي.

packs.about: Code-based motion graphics with real taste.
An apprentice that learns how you edit, plus cut, sound and color.
packs.about_ar: مساعد بيتعلّم طريقتك في المونتاج، ومعاه القص والصوت والألوان.

skills.name: arabic-captions
skills.description: Creates correct Arabic subtitles and burned-in captions. Covers SRT/ASS files, right-to-left punctuation fixes, Arabic font rendering in ffmpeg, line breaking, word-by-word highlight captions for Reels, and export for CapCut, Premiere, and YouTube. Use when the user wants "ترجمة", "كابشن", "سب تايتل", "حط الكلام على الفيديو", Arabic subtitles, or captions that show broken or reversed Arabic.
skills.description_ar: كابشنز عربي الحروف فيها متوصلة، وعلامات الترقيم والإنجليزي في مكانهم، وتلوين كلمة كلمة، وتصدير لكل البرامج.

skills.name: arabic-hooks
skills.description: Writes scroll-stopping Arabic hooks and video openings (first 1–15 seconds) in the creator's own dialect, using formulas proven on Arabic Reels, TikTok, Shorts and YouTube. Use when the user asks for "هوك", "بداية الفيديو", "أول جملة", "مقدمة تشد", an Arabic hook, or wants hook options for an Arabic script.
skills.description_ar: بتكتب هوك يشد في أول ٣ ثواني بلهجتك، بـ١٢ معادلة مجرّبة على الريلز وتيك توك واليوتيوب.

skills.name: arabic-market-research
skills.description: Researches the Arabic content market for a niche (what's working on Arabic YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, competitor channels, audience questions, seasonal moments like Ramadan, and gaps between English and Arabic content) and turns it into video angles. Use when the user asks "إيه اللي شغال في المجال ده", "حلل المنافسين", "أفكار فيديوهات", "إيه الناقص في المحتوى العربي", or wants research before making Arabic content.
skills.description_ar: بتحلل السوق العربي في مجالك: المنافسين، وأسئلة الجمهور، والناقص بالعربي مقارنة بالإنجليزي، ومواسم زي رمضان.

skills.name: arabic-motion-typography
skills.description: Animates Arabic text correctly and beautifully in Remotion, HTML/CSS/GSAP and After Effects-style workflows. Covers right-to-left layout, word-level (never letter-level) animation, Arabic fonts, mixed Arabic/English, digits, diacritics clipping, and kinetic typography synced to speech. Use when making Arabic titles, kinetic text, lower thirds, animated captions or any motion graphic with Arabic text, or when Arabic letters appear disconnected, reversed, or cut off in an animation.
skills.description_ar: تحريك النص العربي في Remotion و GSAP من غير ما الحروف تتقطّع أو الترتيب يتعكس، حتى مع الكلام الإنجليزي والأرقام.

skills.name: arabic-script
skills.description: Writes complete Arabic video scripts (YouTube long-form, explainers, tutorials, talking-head, faceless) that keep viewers watching, in the creator's dialect, with timing based on Arabic speech rate and a visual cue for every beat. Use when the user wants "سكريبت", "اكتبلي فيديو", "سيناريو يوتيوب", an Arabic YouTube script, or to turn an article/idea into an Arabic video.
skills.description_ar: سكريبت يوتيوب كامل بلهجتك، متظبط على سرعة الكلام العربي، وجنب كل جملة اللي هيظهر على الشاشة.

skills.name: arabic-shorts
skills.description: Plans and writes Arabic short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat Spotlight) end-to-end in one pass, covering hook, 20–60 s script, shot list, on-screen text, caption and hashtags, tuned for Arab audiences and RTL screens. Use when the user asks for "ريل", "ريلز", "تيك توك", "شورتس", "فيديو قصير", or a quick vertical video in Arabic.
skills.description_ar: ريل أو تيك توك أو شورت كامل في رد واحد: هوك، وسكريبت، ولقطات، ونص على الشاشة، وكابشن، وهاشتاجات، وكله في الأماكن الآمنة.

skills.name: arabic-titles-thumbnails
skills.description: Creates Arabic YouTube titles and thumbnail text as a matched pair, handling right-to-left layout, mixed Arabic/English, digit style, length limits, and readability at phone size. Use when the user asks for "عنوان", "عناوين يوتيوب", "نص الثمبنيل", "تصميم الصورة المصغرة", or Arabic titles/thumbnails for a video.
skills.description_ar: العنوان ونص الثمبنيل مع بعض: طول مناسب للموبايل، ومكان النص صح من اليمين للشمال، وخطوط عربية تتقري.

skills.name: arabic-transcript-cleanup
skills.description: Cleans Arabic speech transcripts from Whisper, YouTube auto-captions or other tools. It fixes dialect words the AI turned into فصحى, restores English terms written in Arabic letters, marks filler words (يعني، بص، إممم) with timestamps for cutting, and produces a clean transcript plus a cut list. Use when the user has an Arabic transcript, wants to remove fillers, "نضّف التفريغ", "شيل يعني وإممم", or prepares Arabic footage for editing or captions.
skills.description_ar: بتنضّف التفريغ العربي: بترجّع كلام اللهجة اللي اتحوّل فصحى، وبتصلّح المصطلحات الإنجليزي، وبتعلّم على الحشو عشان يتقص.

skills.name: arabic-voice
skills.description: Captures an Arab creator's real speaking voice (dialect, rhythm, signature phrases, code-switching) into a reusable Voice Card, and rewrites stiff or AI-sounding Arabic into natural spoken Arabic. Use before writing any Arabic script, caption, or post; when the user says "اكتب بأسلوبي", "خليه بالمصري/بالخليجي", "الكلام ده شكله AI", "عايزه طبيعي", or shares past videos/captions as a voice reference.
skills.description_ar: بتطلّع «كارت الصوت» بتاعك (لهجتك، وطريقتك، وجملك المميزة)، وبتحوّل أي كلام رسمي أو شكله AI لكلامك الطبيعي.

skills.name: arabic-youtube-seo
skills.description: Optimizes Arabic YouTube videos for search (keywords across dialects and فصحى, spelling variants, Arabizi, bilingual descriptions, tags, chapters, and hashtags) so videos are found from every Arab country. Use when the user asks for "سيو يوتيوب", "وصف الفيديو", "تاجات", "كلمات مفتاحية", "chapters بالعربي", or Arabic YouTube metadata.
skills.description_ar: سيو يوتيوب بالعربي: كلمات مفتاحية بكل اللهجات وطرق الكتابة، ووصف، وchapters، وتاجات، وهاشتاجات.

skills.name: colorist
skills.description: The studio's Colorist. Owns the color of a video for the studio-director, covering log/HDR conversion, exposure and white balance correction, shot matching, a creative look the user picks from a contact sheet, skin tones, legal levels and correct Rec.709 tagging, and reports back with a Color Handoff and a reusable LUT. Picks and runs color-grade (LUTs via ffmpeg) or gives exact settings for Resolve, Premiere, Final Cut or CapCut. Use when the director reaches the color pass, or when the user says the footage looks flat, washed out, too orange/blue, the shots don't match, wants a cinematic look, a LUT, or says "تلوين", "كلر جريدنج", "الألوان باهتة", "عايز لوك سينمائي".
skills.description_ar: الكولريست بتاع الاستوديو، وبيرجع للمخرج: بيصلّح الإضاءة والوايت بالانس، ويحوّل اللوج والـHDR، ويظبط اللقطات على بعض، ويقترح لوكات تختار منها، ويسلّم الفيديو متلوّن وLUT تستخدمها تاني.

skills.name: distribution-lead
skills.description: The studio's Distribution Lead. Owns stage 7 for the studio-director, covering platform-correct exports, vertical and square versions, cut-downs and repurposed posts, a posting schedule, a publish checklist, the first-48-hours follow-up, and a lessons report that feeds the next video. Delivers a Distribution Handoff. Picks and runs reframe-social, yt-shorts, youtube-clip-extractor, social-content-creation, text-content, x-article-converter, x-posting, email-writing, yt-comment and yt-retention. Use when the director reaches export/publishing, or when the user asks to export for each platform, make shorts/reels from a video, repurpose, plan when to post, publish, or check how a video did, or says "صدّرلي الفيديو", "اعمل منه ريلز", "انشره", "امتى أنزّله", "الفيديو جاب كام".
skills.description_ar: مسؤول النشر في الاستوديو، وبيرجع للمخرج: يصدّر نسخة مظبوطة لكل منصة، ويطلّع ريلز وشورتس من الفيديو، ويعمل جدول نشر، وما بينشرش حاجة من غير موافقتك، وبعد ٤٨ ساعة بيقولك الفيديو عمل إيه والدرس للفيديو الجاي.

skills.name: motion-designer
skills.description: The studio's Motion Designer. Owns stage 4 (motion graphics) for the studio-director, taking a Motion Brief and delivering a finished motion package (look, storyboard, animated titles, lower thirds, kinetic text, transitions, renders with alpha) plus a handoff report back to the director. Picks and runs the right motion skills (motion-design, remotion-motion-graphics, remotion-graphics, motion-design-html, arabic-motion-typography, web-sims, sound-design, review-loop). Use when the director reaches the motion stage, or when the user asks for motion graphics, an animated intro/outro, a logo reveal, kinetic typography, lower thirds, animated captions or explainer animation, or says "موشن جرافيك", "انيميشن للنص", "انترو متحرك", "عايز موشن للفيديو".
skills.description_ar: الموشن ديزاينر بتاع الاستوديو، وبيرجع للمخرج: بياخد البريف ويعمل ستايل الموشن، والستوري بورد، والعناوين واللوور ثيردز والنص المتحرك، ويراجع كل فريم، ويسلّم الملفات وتقرير للمخرج.

skills.name: packaging-lead
skills.description: The studio's Packaging Lead. Owns stage 6 for the studio-director, turning the finished video into everything a viewer sees before and around it, which covers the title and thumbnail as one pair, captions/subtitles, description, chapters, tags, hashtags, pinned comment and end screen. Delivers a Package Handoff. Picks and runs yt-package, arabic-titles-thumbnails, youtube-title-creator, arabic-captions, captions, video-caption-creation, yt-seo, arabic-youtube-seo, yt-chapters and nano-banana-image-generator. Use when the director reaches packaging, or when the user asks for a title, thumbnail, captions, description, chapters, tags or "everything I need to upload", or says "عنوان وثمبنيل", "اكتبلي الوصف", "شابترز", "كابشن للفيديو", "جهّزلي الرفع".
skills.description_ar: مسؤول التغليف في الاستوديو، وبيرجع للمخرج: العنوان والثمبنيل كزوج واحد، والكابشنز، والوصف، والشابترز، والتاجز، والتعليق المثبّت، وبيتأكد إن الفيديو بيوفّي بالوعد في أول ٣٠ ثانية.

skills.name: sound-designer
skills.description: The studio's Sound Designer. Owns the sound of a video for the studio-director, covering dialogue cleanup, music bed and ducking, sound effects synced to picture and motion, the final mix, loudness per platform, and stems, and reports back with a Sound Handoff. Picks and runs audio-edit, sound-design, filler-removal and edl-edit music. Use when the director reaches the sound pass, or when the user asks to fix or mix audio, add music or SFX, make the voice sound better, set loudness for YouTube/Reels/podcast, or says "ظبط الصوت", "الصوت واطي", "حط مزيكا", "مؤثرات صوتية", "ساوند ديزاين".
skills.description_ar: الساوند ديزاينر بتاع الاستوديو، وبيرجع للمخرج: بينضّف الصوت، ويحط المزيكا (أو من غير مزيكا لو حابب) والمؤثرات على الموشن، ويعمل الميكس على −14 LUFS، ويسلّم الميكس والـstems وتقرير بالأرقام.

skills.name: studio-director
skills.description: The director of Full Production Studio. Takes a raw video idea and runs it through the whole pipeline (idea → script → visual plan → motion → edit → captions → export), picking the right skill at every stage and keeping one project brief in sync. Use when the user wants to make a whole video end-to-end, says "make me a video/reel/short about…", "where do I start", "اعملي فيديو عن…", "عايز أعمل ريل", or is unsure which skill to use.
skills.description_ar: المخرج: بياخد فكرة الفيديو ويمشّيها على الخط كله (فكرة ← سكريبت ← مشاهد ← موشن ← مونتاج ← كابشنز ← تصدير)، ويختار السكيل المناسبة لكل مرحلة، ويراجع النتيجة قبل ما يكمّل.

skills.name: find-your-margin
skills.description: Help a knowledge worker find where their attention earns the fattest margin when combined with AI. Maps their skill stack against AI capabilities to identify high-surplus opportunities vs. commodity traps. Use when someone asks where to focus their AI efforts, how to avoid the allocation economy race-to-zero, or how to build a defensible position as an individual operator.

skills.name: invisible-threads
skills.description: Discovers non-obvious thematic connections ("invisible threads") across a corpus of essays, articles, or transcripts.

skills.name: seo-research
skills.description: Strategic keyword research and content planning. Use this skill BEFORE writing to identify opportunities, validate topics, and create a research brief.

skills.name: youtube
skills.description: The ultimate YouTube creator skill. Covers channel audits, video SEO, retention-engineered scripts, hook writing, thumbnail briefs, content strategy, content calendars, Shorts optimisation, analytics interpretation, monetisation planning, competitor research, cross-platform repurposing, upload metadata packages, and data-driven video idea generation. Triggers on: "youtube", "channel", "video", "views", "subscribers", "watch time", "shorts", "thumbnail", "CTR", "retention", "monetize", "script", "hook", "upload", "youtube audit", "video ideas", "content calendar", "competitor analysis", "repurpose video", "youtube seo", "youtube strategy", "youtube analytics".
skills.note: Optional Python scripts in execution/ need a YouTube Data API key.

skills.name: yt-audit
skills.description: Audit a YouTube channel end to end - packaging, consistency, the first fifteen seconds, and what to fix first. Use for "audit my channel", "why isn't my channel growing", "review my videos", or a pasted channel URL.

skills.name: yt-plan
skills.description: Plan a week or a month of YouTube uploads - what to post, when, and in what order, sized to the creator's actual capacity. Use for "plan my week", "content calendar", "what should I post", "I have no idea what to make next".

skills.name: yt-retention
skills.description: Read a YouTube Studio audience-retention export and find where viewers actually leave, then say what to change. Use for "why do people stop watching", "my retention is bad", a pasted retention chart or CSV, or "fix my pacing".

skills.name: yt-viral
skills.description: Find what is actually working in the user's niche on YouTube and rank it by how far each video beat its own channel, then name the formula. Use for "what's working right now", "find viral videos in my niche", "why did this blow up", competitor research, or a swipe file.

skills.name: ai-tells
skills.description: Checklist of patterns that make writing sound AI-generated (filler openers, stacked connectors, rule of three, hedging). Use when reviewing or de-AI-ing a draft (newsletters, social posts, blog posts, emails) or when the user says a text sounds like AI.

skills.name: anti-ai-writing
skills.description: Transform AI-assisted drafts into authentic, human-sounding content. This skill provides patterns to detect and eliminate AI tells, frameworks for natural writing, and techniques for creating prose that reads as genuinely human. Use when reviewing any AI-generated content or when writing content that must not appear AI-assisted.

skills.name: cold-open-creator
skills.description: Create 25-35 second cold opens that hook listeners by dropping them into a specific moment that encapsulates the episode's themes. Merge Descript's character-driven narrative with Colin & Samir's rearrangement technique.

skills.name: dude-with-sign-writer
skills.description: Creates punchy, conversational one-liners in "Dude With Sign" style - bold statements that challenge norms, validate feelings, or poke fun at everyday truths. Use when creating short social captions, easel reveal messages, or single-sentence hooks. Not for long-form content or formal messaging.

skills.name: email-writing
skills.description: Write authentic, human-sounding emails that build relationships and drive action. This skill should be used when drafting welcome emails, follow-ups, newsletters, announcements, outreach, or any email communication. Integrates with human-writing principles to avoid AI tells. Particularly suited for community building, movement organizing, and personal relationship management contexts.

skills.name: ghostwriter
skills.description: Turn source material (notes, transcripts, outlines) into authentic, human-sounding writing such as newsletters, articles, social posts and emails, using voice transformation and AI-pattern detection. Use when the user asks you to ghostwrite or turn material into a finished written piece.

skills.name: hook-and-headline-writing
skills.description: Create attention-grabbing hooks and headlines using 15 proven formulas, sticky techniques, and the 4 U's test. This skill provides systematic frameworks for generating volume (10+ options) and selecting the best performers. Use for newsletter subject lines, social media hooks, blog headlines, or any content that needs to stop the scroll.

skills.name: how-newsletters
skills.description: Writing style reference based on case studies of successful newsletters. This skill should be used when the user wants to write in the distinctive voice and style of professional newsletter writers, or when creating content that needs to feel authentic and human rather than AI-generated.

skills.name: human-writing
skills.description: Transform AI-assisted drafts into authentic, distinctive prose. Use this skill when (1) reviewing or humanizing AI-generated content, (2) writing content that must not appear AI-assisted, (3) converting transcripts or source material into polished prose, (4) maintaining Charlie Deist's voice across content. Triggers on requests to "make it sound human", "remove AI tells", "write in my voice", or any content editing/writing task.

skills.name: meta-ads-creative
skills.description: Create high-converting Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad creative using the 6 Elements framework, proven ad formats, and research-driven copywriting. Optimized for lo-fi, native-feeling ads that don't look like ads.

skills.name: podcast-blog-post-creator
skills.description: Transform podcast episodes into compelling, SEO-optimized blog posts in a conversational voice. Creates narrative-driven explainers (~1,000 words) that weave guest expertise with real-world storytelling.

skills.name: podcast-production
skills.description: Complete workflow for producing podcast episodes from raw transcript to publishable YouTube and social media assets. Four-checkpoint system for strategic decision-making plus final polished assets.

skills.name: seo-content-writer
skills.description: Write SEO-optimized content that ranks AND reads like a human wrote it. Use this skill AFTER completing research with `seo-research` skill.

skills.name: short-form-video
skills.description: Create short-form video content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) using practitioner methodology. Covers production workflow from concept to publish, hook construction, format selection, and algorithm optimization.

skills.name: social-content-creation
skills.description: Transform newsletters, articles, and podcasts into platform-optimized social posts using 180+ proven templates. This skill uses the framework fitting method to extract standalone concepts, match them to proven formats, generate volume, and multiply winners. Use for repurposing long-form content to LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Instagram.

skills.name: text-content
skills.description: Create high-performing text posts for social media using framework fitting method. 360+ proven templates across LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and Instagram. Progressive disclosure loads only relevant templates based on platform and content type.

skills.name: transcript-polisher
skills.description: Transform raw podcast transcripts into polished, readable documents. This skill removes filler words, fixes grammar, adds structure, and preserves authentic voice. Use when processing podcast transcripts, interview recordings, video captions, or any spoken content that needs cleanup while maintaining 100% fidelity to meaning.

skills.name: video-caption-creation
skills.description: Create on-screen text hooks and captions for short-form video clips. Built around the Complementarity Principle - on-screen text should ADD to what the viewer hears, not repeat it. Includes podcast clip workflow, hook categories, and Triple Word Score optimization.

skills.name: voice-pirate-wires
skills.description: Write in the Pirate Wires style - authentic, conversational, contrarian. This voice is direct and confident with irreverent humor, takes obvious-but-unsaid positions, and sounds like a smart friend explaining something they've figured out. Use with anti-ai-writing for tech commentary, cultural criticism, or any content requiring a strong point of view.

skills.name: writing-style
skills.description: Prose and voice standards (anti-AI patterns, voice principles, sentence style) originally written for another team's newsletter. Use when the user asks for a style pass or an edit on written content; not for video scripts.

skills.name: x-article-converter
skills.description: Convert blog posts or newsletters into X/Twitter articles with handles inserted and a posting strategy. Use when the user wants to turn an article into X content, create a tweetstorm, or promote content on Twitter/X with expert tagging. (project)

skills.name: x-posting
skills.description: Post and schedule content to X/Twitter. Use when batch processing social posts, promoting podcasts/blogs, or scheduling content. Handles guest tagging, template matching, and getlate.dev API integration.

skills.name: youtube-script-writer
skills.description: Write a high-retention YouTube script — explainer, tutorial, video essay, review, or talking head — on the packaging then cold-open then value-stack then retention structure that holds watch time past the drop-off cliffs. Use when asked to write a YouTube script, script a long-form or explainer video, draft a video hook, outline a video essay, or turn a blog post or talk into a video. Produces title and thumbnail concepts, multiple hook options, a beat-by-beat body with retention devices, and clear visual and audio cues.

skills.name: youtube-title-creator
skills.description: Generate high-CTR YouTube titles and thumbnails using framework fitting method. Match content to 119 proven formulas from Creator Hooks, apply psychological principles, test variations.

skills.name: yt-chapters
skills.description: Write YouTube chapters from a transcript, validated against YouTube's own rules so they actually render. Use for "add chapters", "timestamps", "break this video into sections".

skills.name: yt-comment
skills.description: Draft replies to YouTube comments in the creator's voice, triaged by which ones are worth answering. Use for "reply to my comments", "handle the comment section", "someone asked X", or a pasted comment thread.

skills.name: yt-package
skills.description: Write and lint the title and thumbnail for a YouTube video as one pairing, checking truncation, duplication and vagueness before publish. Use for "title ideas", "what should I call this", "thumbnail text", "my CTR is bad", packaging, or any request to rename or repackage an existing video.

skills.name: yt-script
skills.description: Write a YouTube video script from a raw idea - hook options off 21 formulas, scored, then the full spoken script with the retention beats marked. Use whenever the user wants a video script, a hook, an opening line, "what should I say", "write my next video", or is about to record and does not have the first fifteen seconds yet.

skills.name: yt-seo
skills.description: Write the description, tags and search-facing text for a YouTube video, aimed at the query a real person types. Use for "write my description", "tags", "SEO", "help this video get found", "nobody is finding this".

skills.name: yt-shorts
skills.description: Find the Shorts hiding inside a long video and write them, using the transcript to pick self-contained moments. Use for "cut this into shorts", "clip this", "repurpose this video", "what should I clip".

skills.name: motion-design
skills.description: Taste rules for Remotion motion graphics — timing, easing, springs, typography, color, texture, and scene continuity, with concrete numbers. Use whenever you create, animate, retime, or polish a video, composition, scene, or transition in this repo.

skills.name: motion-design-html
skills.description: Code-only motion design pipeline (no After Effects) for Raphaël / Howseen: launch films, showreels, product promos, LinkedIn/X videos, meme clips. Use when asked to make a motion design video, a promo/launch film, a showreel, "remake this video", a video from a prompt (e.g. "make a 15s motion graphics video…"), to change a video's music/SFX, or to prepare memes for posts. Covers the brief → beat map → stills → seek(t) HTML engine → Playwright render → ffmpeg → music/SFX → QA flow, plus asset sourcing (Mixkit, Pexels, Unsplash, svgl, 21st.dev) and every gotcha hit so far.
skills.note: Needs Node + Playwright + ffmpeg (and Python for the helper scripts).

skills.name: nano-banana-image-generator
skills.description: Generate AI images using Nano Banana Pro (Gemini). Use this skill when the user needs images - thumbnails, social posts, blog headers, or creative visuals. Follows an iterative workflow - brainstorm concepts, select direction, generate in multiple styles, then produce via API.
skills.note: Needs a Google Gemini API key.

skills.name: remotion-graphics
skills.description: Create ANIMATED motion graphics — kinetic word-by-word captions, animated lower-thirds/name tags, branded intro/outro title cards, data-driven graphics (count-ups, growing bars) — as React/Remotion components, rendered to a transparent layer and composited over the footage with ffmpeg. OPTIONAL/heavy (needs Node + a headless-Chromium download, and a Remotion license for company use). Use only when an edit needs genuine motion design that PIL/ffmpeg overlays can't do; for a static label, watermark, or simple fade, use the video-overlay skill instead.

skills.name: remotion-motion-graphics
skills.description: Create and edit motion graphics videos with Remotion (React): intros and outros, logo animations, promos, text animations, captions on footage, and compositing images and B-roll. Use when the user wants a motion graphics video built in Remotion, is working in a Remotion project, or says their Remotion video looks generic or amateur. Read it before writing Remotion code.

skills.name: review-loop
skills.description: Visual self-review loop for motion graphics — render a draft, build contact sheets at every timeline beat, look at them, critique against a checklist, fix, repeat. Use after any change to a video's visuals or timing, and before calling a video done.

skills.name: sound-design
skills.description: Procedural sound design with the sfx engine — writing a cue sheet against a video's timeline, which sound goes with which visual event, gain hierarchy, panning, musical key, automatic mastering to -14 LUFS, adding new generators, and verifying sync. Use when adding, changing or checking audio, SFX, music beds or loudness for any video in this repo.

skills.name: video-overlay
skills.description: Composite a graphic onto video — text, a logo/image, a static transparent PNG, or an animated effect — and place it accurately, including locking it to a moving subject (a face, eye, hand, object). Use whenever the user wants to add/overlay/burn-in/stick something onto footage, place a watermark or label, or position a graphic precisely. Covers transparency (RGBA), animated overlays, timed windows, and coordinate-finding.

skills.name: video-transitions
skills.description: Join two clips with a visible transition effect (wipe, slide, dissolve, pixelize, circle open/close, fade-to-black, etc.) using ffmpeg xfade. Use whenever the user wants a transition between shots/scenes, a scene change with an effect, or anything beyond a hard cut. For a barely-visible seam between adjacent cuts use the splice command instead; for generative effects on the footage itself use grok-video-edit.

skills.name: web-sims
skills.description: Build a simulation-style video (agents, particles, 3D machines, fly-throughs) as one HTML page whose render(t) is a pure function of time, then capture it frame by frame to a 60 fps mp4 with sims/capture.mjs. Use when the idea is a simulation or a 3D object rather than motion graphics with text and UI.

skills.name: audio-edit
skills.description: Clean up or mix a video's audio track — normalize loudness, reduce background noise/hiss, or add background music (optionally ducked under speech). Use whenever the user wants to fix quiet/loud/inconsistent audio, remove hiss/hum, or lay music under a talking-head/voiceover. For removing um/uh filler words use filler-removal instead; for replacing the audio entirely use plain ffmpeg map.

skills.name: captions
skills.description: Add subtitles/captions to a video — burn them into the picture, or export an .srt/.vtt file (for YouTube etc.). Use whenever the user wants captions, subtitles, on-screen text of what's being said, an SRT/VTT file, or accessibility text. Covers auto-transcription, editing for accuracy, styling, and the verbatim-vs-clean gotcha.

skills.name: color-grade
skills.description: Color-grade a video — apply a cinematic look / LUT, or generate and compare candidate looks for the user to pick. Use whenever footage looks flat/muted/cold and needs grading, you want a named reusable look (warm, teal-orange, punchy, neutral), or you have a .cube LUT to apply. Covers applying .cube/HALD LUTs via ffmpeg, baking a look from a color-filter chain, and the "render a few looks, let me choose" workflow.

skills.name: cutting-rhythm
skills.description: Make an edit feel flowing, natural and snappy rather than merely accurate — split edits (J/L cuts), where to place a cut relative to speech and motion, how long to hold a shot, collapsing dead air, and cutting on the beat. Use whenever an edit is technically correct but feels choppy, abrupt, draggy, monotone or "AI-edited", when the user asks to tighten/pace/smooth a cut, or before finalizing any multi-clip edit. Complements edl-edit (which is the mechanics of the cut list) with the timing decisions that make it watchable.

skills.name: editor
skills.description: Turn raw footage into a finished edit in a specific genre/format — montage, documentary, tutorial, news, workshop, vlog, trailer, explainer. Use whenever the user wants the video "edited into a X", asks "what style should this be / what would make a good X", or hands over raw footage without spelling out every cut. This is the director: it understands the footage first, picks a treatment, then composes the other skills (edl-edit, cutting-rhythm, filler-removal, captions, reframe-social, video-transitions, video-overlay, audio-edit, color-grade, remotion-graphics, grok-video-edit) to execute it.

skills.name: editor-apprentice
skills.description: Turns Claude into a video editor's apprentice. Claude asks the editor to teach it how they work with each client, splits that workflow into stages, works the stages the editor hands over (one at a time, under their corrections), learns from their final cut, and writes everything into an editor skill plus one skill per client. Works with any editing or motion app (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut and others) through project files, scripting, MCP servers or computer use, in any language. Use it whenever a video editor, montage editor, motion designer or مونتير wants to teach Claude their workflow, onboard a new client or channel, start or continue an episode or project for a client, compare their final cut with Claude's work, or build/update a skill for a client or for themselves — even if they never say "skill" or "apprentice".
skills.note: Claude Code only; needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and faster-whisper (asks before installing).
skills.description_ar: مساعد مونتير بيتعلّم طريقتك إنت لكل عميل، وبيشتغل جوه برامجك (Premiere، Resolve، After Effects، CapCut) مرحلة مرحلة، وبيحفظ اللي اتعلّمه.

skills.name: edl-edit
skills.description: Build a multi-clip edit as an auditable JSON "edit decision list" (EDL) — a list of clips with source/in/out and a written rationale per pick — that one command renders to a finished video. Use whenever you're stitching several cuts/takes/segments into one video and want the edit to be reviewable, diffable, and re-runnable instead of a throwaway ffmpeg filtergraph. Covers the schema, the rationale discipline, multicam cutaways, and verifying the output by re-transcribing it.

skills.name: filler-removal
skills.description: Remove filler words and disfluencies (um, uh, like, you know, basically) from a talking-head video so it sounds like they were never said. Use whenever the user wants to clean up speech, cut filler/hesitations, tighten a voiceover, or remove "um"s and "uh"s. Covers verbatim transcription, precise cutting rules, and the iterate-until-clean preview loop.

skills.name: grok-video-edit
skills.description: Apply AI-generated visual edits to video using xAI / Grok — change object colors, add effects (smoke, fire, sparkles), restyle scenes, or alter what's in a clip ("make the sunglasses red", "add smoke from the gun", "make it sparkly"). Use whenever an edit can't be done deterministically with ffmpeg/overlays and needs generative reimagining of the footage. Covers trimming, chunking, audio mux, and seamless reassembly.

skills.name: reframe-social
skills.description: Reframe a video to a different aspect ratio for social platforms — vertical 9:16 (Reels/Shorts/TikTok), square 1:1, or 4:5 portrait — from horizontal source. Use whenever the user wants to make a video vertical/square, fit it for Instagram/TikTok/YouTube Shorts, repurpose a 16:9 clip for social, or crop/pad to an aspect ratio. Covers crop-vs-pad choice, keeping an off-center subject in frame, and following a moving subject.

skills.name: youtube-clip-extractor
skills.description: Download YouTube videos, identify compelling clips from transcripts, cut clips with ffmpeg, and generate platform-optimized on-screen text and captions. Complete workflow from URL to publishable clips.

skills.name: youtube-downloader
skills.description: Download YouTube video transcripts when user provides a YouTube URL or asks to download/get/fetch a transcript from YouTube. Also use when user wants to transcribe or get captions/subtitles from a YouTube video.

skills.name: yt-edit
skills.description: Turn a raw recording's transcript into an edit decision list - dead air, filler cues and retakes, with timecodes. Use for "edit this", "cut the dead space", "tighten this video", "I rambled", or any request to shorten footage from a transcript.
